description: The 'projects_summary' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various projects, capturing essential details and performance metrics. It is designed to help project managers and stakeholders track project progress, understand project scope, and evaluate performance. Each project is uniquely identified by a 'projectKey' and described with a 'project_name' and 'shortDesc'. The dataset includes detailed descriptions of project objectives and processes, as well as the 'project_owner' responsible for each project. Key performance indicators such as 'projectStatus', 'last_modified_timestamp', and 'most_recent_commit' provide insights into the current state and recent activities of the projects. Additionally, the dataset tracks the number of commits, unique committing users, and runtime statistics, which are crucial for assessing project activity and efficiency. The inclusion of 'tags' allows for categorization and easy retrieval of projects based on specific focus areas. This dataset is particularly useful for organizations using Dataiku DSS, as it integrates with the platform to provide real-time updates and facilitate data-driven decision-making. Overall, the 'projects_summary' dataset is a valuable tool for managing and optimizing project workflows.
shortDesc: Project management dataset with project details and performance metrics.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each project, essential for tracking.

columns.name: project_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of the project, indicating its purpose.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Brief description of the project, including creation details.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Detailed project description, outlining objectives and processes.

columns.name: project_owner
columns.comment: Email or login of the project owner, indicating responsibility.

columns.name: projectStatus
columns.comment: Current status of the project, such as 'In production'.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Array of tags categorizing the project, indicating focus areas.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the last modification, showing recent updates.

columns.name: tutorialProject
columns.comment: Boolean indicating if the project is a tutorial, for learning.

columns.name: project_url
columns.comment: Direct URL to the project, for easy access and navigation.

columns.name: most_recent_commit
columns.comment: Date of the most recent commit, indicating latest changes.

columns.name: num_days_since_last_commit
columns.comment: Days since the last commit, showing project activity.

columns.name: num_unique_committing_users
columns.comment: Number of unique users committing to the project.

columns.name: num_commits
columns.comment: Total number of commits made to the project.

columns.name: most_recent_runtime
columns.comment: Date of the most recent runtime, indicating recent execution.

columns.name: longest_runtime_sec
columns.comment: Longest runtime in seconds, showing maximum execution time.

columns.name: avg_runtime_sec
columns.comment: Average runtime in seconds, indicating typical execution time.

columns.name: total_runtime_sec
columns.comment: Total runtime in seconds, showing cumulative execution time.

columns.name: avg_num_errors
columns.comment: Average number of errors, indicating error frequency.

columns.name: total_errors
columns.comment: Total number of errors, showing overall error count.

columns.name: avg_warnings
columns.comment: Average number of warnings, indicating warning frequency.

columns.name: total_warnings
columns.comment: Total number of warnings, showing overall warning count.

columns.name: num_jobs_and_scenarios
columns.comment: Number of jobs and scenarios, indicating project complexity.
